title: Conditional Residual Prediction: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion without a Bidirectional Teacher
title_zh: 条件残差预测：无需双向教师模型即可提升自回归视频扩散模型的性能

paragraphs.en: 该研究提出了一种名为Conditional Residual Prediction (CRP)的方法，通过减少模型对条件的依赖来提高因果视频扩散模型的生成质量。 Causal video diffusion models generate video autoregressively, which suits streaming, interactive, and long-video generation. Under standard training, however, they often yield lower generation quality than bidirectional models of the same size. Many existing approaches address this gap by initializing from or distilling a pretrained bidirectional teacher. We instead train a causal model from an image-model initialization, with no bidirectional video model at any stage. Because this path requires neither a large bidirectional teacher nor a complex distillation pipeline, it is simpler and more scalable. On this path, we find that a causal model trained on ground-truth history becomes strongly dependent on it, so that at inference errors in its own generated history propagate forward. We hypothesize that much of this dependence is unnecessary, because the current input already determines much of what the history provides. We propose Conditional Residual Prediction (CRP), a simple recipe for reducing a model's reliance on a condition: the model first predicts the target without the condition, and the condition may only add a residual on top of this prediction. Applied to history, CRP makes the model predict each chunk from the present as far as it can and use the past only for what the present cannot supply. In controlled experiments, CRP nearly closes the 6.14-point gap to a bidirectional model trained under the same setup. Scaling this recipe, we train Optica, a 2B-parameter causal video model that autoregressively generates 5-second 480p videos and reaches 82.78 on VBench with only about 15M training videos.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究提出了一种名为条件残差预测（CRP）的方法，通过减少模型对条件的依赖来提高因果视频扩散模型的生成质量。因果视频扩散模型以自回归方式生成视频，适合流式传输、交互式生成和长视频生成。 然而，在标准训练下，它们的生成质量通常低于相同规模的双向模型。 许多现有方法通过从预训练的双向教师模型初始化或蒸馏来解决这一差距。 我们则采用图像模型初始化来训练因果模型，整个过程中不使用任何双向视频模型。 由于这种方法既不需要大型的双向教师模型，也不需要复杂的蒸馏流程，因此更简单且更具可扩展性。 在这一路径中，我们发现，在真实历史数据上训练的因果模型会对其产生强烈依赖，导致推理时自身生成的历史数据中的错误会向前传播。 我们推测，这种依赖在很大程度上是不必要的，因为当前输入已经决定了历史数据所能提供的许多信息。 我们提出了条件残差预测（CRP），一种减少模型对条件依赖的简单方法：模型首先在没有条件的情况下预测目标，而条件只能在此预测之上添加一个残差。 将CRP应用于历史数据时，模型会尽可能从当前信息出发预测每个片段，仅在过去信息无法提供的部分才使用历史数据。 在受控实验中，CRP几乎消除了与在同一设置下训练的双向模型之间6.14分的性能差距。 通过扩展这一方法，我们训练出了Optica——一个拥有20亿参数的因果视频模型，能够自回归生成5秒长的480p视频，并在VBench上达到82.78分，且仅使用了约1500万条训练视频。
